The patient_id is not expected to have any arithmetic or measurement meaning, as it is a descriptive attribute rather than a quantitative measurement or location indicator. The dataset context suggests that patient_id is used to uniquely identify patient entities within the encounter domain, and it is likely that the same patient can have multiple entries in the dataset due to the nature of encounters or multiple visits.
